about: Models DockLlama has been tested with. Used only for the first guess and download suggestions; real results come from testing on the user's own server. Scores are DockLlama's 8-scenario benchmark (Nov 22 2026, before the S2/S8 rubric fix). Reference times: Thor = RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB, .97 = Ryzen 7 8745HS with Radeon 780M iGPU. Sizes are ollama.com library download sizes.

models.name: gemma4:latest
models.notes: Fastest strong model on both test machines.

models.name: gpt-oss:20b
models.notes: Mixture-of-experts, so it runs well even without a big GPU if there's enough RAM. Thinking can't be fully turned off; DockLlama uses the lowest level.

models.name: llama3.1:8b
models.notes: Doesn't think, so it's predictable and quick on mid-range cards.

models.name: gemma4:e4b-it-qat
models.notes: Quantization-aware build of gemma4; a good fit for CPUs and integrated graphics.

excluded.ornith:9b: Scored highest (98.2) but is Qwen-based; left out pending a decision.
excluded.magistral:24b: Times out wherever thinking runs; slow on 16 GB cards.
excluded.mistral-small3.2: Spills to CPU on 16 GB cards (4-7 tokens/s).
